featured_reviews.name: Ajinkya Narwade
featured_reviews.review_text: “Absolutely fantastic experience at The Smokehouse Grill! The food was fresh, flavorful, and cooked to perfection. Every dish we ordered was packed with taste and served beautifully. The staff was welcoming, attentive, and made us feel valued throughout our visit. The ambience is warm and inviting, making it a great place for family dinners, casual outings, or special occasions. What impressed me most was the consistency in quality and service. It’s not easy to find a restaurant that gets everything right, but The Smokehouse Grill certainly does. Highly recommended, and I’ll definitely be coming back!”

featured_reviews.name: Sonit Agrahari
featured_reviews.review_text:
The place is wonderful with the only downside being it's lack of seating facilities and the shop is quite small. The food is peak and so is the service. You would think the pricing is a little more than what the quantity denotes, but it's very delicious and the quality is also good. What we all liked was the bitter chicken.
It's definitely worth a try and to go at multiple times .

featured_reviews.name: Rustom bhesania
featured_reviews.review_text:
Hi Mario (The Smokehouse Grill)
Thank you for delivering the dinner order. We had a wonderful experience and thoroughly enjoyed.
The rolls (kolkata chicken Tikka, mutton seekh and chicken butter fry) were all super delicious and juicy, just melting in the mouth.
Loved the chicken Lucknowi Biryani. The taste was simply aromatic and  the baida roti was very nice, less oil used and wholesome.

We would love to try your kebabs, roti and gravy for sure which will be next on our list to taste.

Thank you and wishing you success and prosperity.

Keep it going! 👍

featured_reviews.name: Krisha Ebrahimpurkar
featured_reviews.review_text: The food was really amazing. We had some tikkas and decided to try other options. Totally worth it. The hosts were very welcoming and helpful.

featured_reviews.name: Ravi Kewlani
featured_reviews.review_text:
Smokehouse Grill is truly an experience in itself! 🔥✨ The food is cooked to perfection and every dish is absolutely delicious 😋🍗🍛
The tikkas, biryani, gravies, and even the sides leave such a rich and flavourful aftertaste that you instantly want to come back for more 🤤❤️ Every bite feels satisfying and memorable!
The place is conveniently located 📍, the service is top class 👏, and everything is extremely reasonably priced for the amazing quality they offer 💯
Once you eat here, you genuinely fall in love with the place forever ❤️🥹
Loads of wishes, success, and blessings to the entire team of Smokehouse Grill 🙌✨ God bless and keep growing 🚀🌟

featured_reviews.review_text:
Review Title: Extremely Unhygienic Food and Rude Staff Behavior

Review:

I had a very disappointing and disturbing experience at this outlet. I visited the store, placed an order, and paid for it. But to my shock, I found hair and even an insect in the food. When I calmly informed one of the staff members named Farheen, instead of apologizing or offering help, she started misbehaving with me. She spoke rudely, denied a refund, and told me to leave the store.

This is completely unacceptable—both in terms of hygiene and customer service. As a paying customer, I deserve basic respect and cleanliness in the food served. I request the management to take this matter seriously, investigate properly, and ensure no customer goes through such an experience again.

featured_reviews.name: Baktesh Kamath
featured_reviews.review_text: Relax is a small vegetarian fast food restaurant near SIWS college and UDCT college in Wadala west. It is typical hangout place for college kids from nearby colleges & school. There is ample parking space in front of and nearby. Inside the restaurant 16 people can sit in closely arranged 4 tables. There are additional 4 tables outside on the common public footpath area. Pav Bhaji is supposed to be the best here. We had tried cheese Pav Bhaji, paneer crispy and manchow soup. Soup was very hot & spicy. Paneer crispy was paneer tossed with crispy Chinese bhel with sweet sauce. Pav bhaji was the only saving grace. Cost wise it is expensive ₹600 for 2 people for dinner. Service is very slow you have to get attention from waiter. Plus they don't accept cards - only cash or gpay. Overall avoidable unless you are big fan of their pav bhaji.

featured_reviews.name: Rohit Pandey
featured_reviews.review_text:
It's good that you can get snacks and food early. However, due to this early preparation, they made some mistakes.

I ordered dosa and medu vada, which are usually delicious elsewhere, but here, the sambar lacked flavor, no proper stuffing of masala in dosa, and the chutney was too bland. I went with my friends, and they also didn't enjoy the food.

featured_reviews.name: Khushbu Mehta
featured_reviews.review_text:
This place was listed as one of the best PavBhaji in Mumbai. Hence we headed here one evening during our stay. Wasn't difficult to locate this place. It was quite crowded. We got a table to sit after ten minutes. They are around 5-6 tables outside and 2-3 tables inside. We ordered for a PavBhaji and Cold Coco. It took about 10-15 minutes for the PavBhaji. The taste was just decent. Good, but nothing extra ordinary. Pavs were soft and fresh. Cold Coco was nice. Overall it costed us 145/-
Wouldn't really call this d best PavBhaji. Lot of people here were ordering Jain PavBhaji here. I guess that must be tasty.

featured_reviews.review_text: We used to come here for like 5 times a week the whole lockdown 🫣❤️❤️loved it then but today we felt difference in little taste and quantity also food served was little cold compared to when it was served to us in Car in lockdown anyways the place it good the staffs are polite, hope the owner/manager takes the feedback and work on the feedback given 🙂🙂

featured_reviews.name: usman khan
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very disappointing experience at Brij Albela, Wadala West. The prices are already too high for items like dahi bada and ice cream, but on top of that they even charged an extra ₹6 for a carry bag separately with the food order. Nowadays many places provide basic packaging with snacks and food items, but here they charge extra for every small thing.

The biggest issue was the behaviour of the counter person and staff. Their attitude was rude, arrogant, and full of ego. Instead of treating customers respectfully, they behave like they are doing a favour. Customer service and hospitality were completely missing.

Such rude behaviour and unfair extra charges are unacceptable. Strict action and proper checking should be taken against this kind of customer treatment.

featured_reviews.name: Vinod Dubey
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have been coming here since my very young days and I and my family really like this place. Brij Albela has great selection of Indian sweets and snack items. We especially enjoy their Pani Puri. I personally love the chaat and rabri, yum...You have your items packed for you or you can enjoy them there itself, sitting outside.. This, however, was not possible earlier as Brij Albela did not have seats, you could only eat while standing. Since the installation of seats, Brij Albela is now also a great place to have short and meetings, and while you are at it, have a quick bite as well..
Their prices though are on the higher side, which I honestly do not mind, but still.. And the staff, they really need to improve their attitude towards customers, they sometimes seem arrogant. Guys, because you have a good product, does not give you right to be arrogant about it....
Apart from this, everything is really nice, sweets fresh and snacks tasty, and they maintain cleanliness.

featured_reviews.name: Sakina Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Ganesh Upahar Griha Hotel

Ganesh Upahar Griha Hotel offers a delightful culinary experience with a wide variety of both vegetarian and non-vegetarian dishes. The ambiance is warm and welcoming, making it a perfect spot for family meals or casual dining with friends.

**Food Quality and Variety:**
The menu features an extensive selection of dishes catering to different tastes. The vegetarian options are plentiful, with fresh ingredients and flavorful spices. Their non-vegetarian offerings are equally impressive, with well-cooked meats and rich, aromatic gravies.

**Service:**
The staff at Ganesh Upahar Griha Hotel are courteous and attentive. Service is prompt, and the team is always ready to accommodate special requests, ensuring a pleasant dining experience.

**Ambiance:**
The restaurant boasts a cozy and clean environment, perfect for a relaxed meal. The decor is simple yet elegant, creating a comfortable atmosphere for diners.

**Price:**
The prices are reasonable and offer good value for money considering the quality and portion sizes.

**Overall Experience:**
Ganesh Upahar Griha Hotel stands out as a great choice for both vegetarians and non-vegetarians. Whether you're looking for a hearty meal or a light snack, this hotel has something for everyone. Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: TeJaS PaTiL
featured_reviews.review_text:
The BEST Canteen is situated inside the Dadar BEST workshop. Originally, it catered exclusively to BEST employees, but now it is open to the general public. It typically opens in the morning at around 8 and stays open until late in the evening. Whether it's breakfast, lunch, or a late-night snack, you can have it in the canteen. Their menu is extensive, offering Maharashtrian, Punjabi, and Chinese dishes. So far, I have tried egg bhurji pav, egg omelette, misal pav, samosa, and poha, and they all taste good. I have no complaints about the food. The highlight of this place, when you visit, is their tea, which is incredibly delicious and sweet.

बेस्ट कॅन्टीन हे दादर बेस्ट वर्कशॉपच्या आत आहे. मुळात, ते केवळ बेस्टच्या कर्मचाऱ्यांना पुरवले जात होते, पण आता ते सर्वसामान्यांसाठी खुले आहे. हे सहसा सकाळी 8 वाजता उघडते आणि संध्याकाळी उशिरापर्यंत उघडे राहते. न्याहारी असो, दुपारचे जेवण असो किंवा रात्री उशिरापर्यंतचा नाश्ता असो, तुम्ही ते कॅन्टीनमध्ये घेऊ शकता. त्यांचा मेनू विस्तृत आहे, त्यात महाराष्ट्रीयन, पंजाबी आणि चायनीज पदार्थ आहेत. आत्तापर्यंत मी अंडी भुर्जी पाव, अंड्याचे ऑम्लेट, मिसळ पाव, समोसे आणि पोहे ट्राय केले आहेत आणि ते सर्व छान लागतात. मला जेवणाबद्दल कोणतीही तक्रार नाही. या ठिकाणाचे खास आकर्षण, तुम्ही भेट देता तेव्हा, त्यांचा चहा निश्चितपणे अतिशय स्वादिष्ट आणि गोड आहे.
